thread:
emily: Heads-up — we got a customer report about fd/connection leaks when using streaming responses in the async Python SDK. FD count climbs with sustained streams and app eventually OOMs.
raj: Oof. Any logs or stack traces?
emily: customer logs show a ResourceWarning from httpx and `open_fds` increasing steadily. snippet: 
```
2026-03-25T10:02:11Z WARN resource: unclosed connector detected
2026-03-25T10:02:11Z INFO telemetry open_fds=842 -> 1270 over 10m
```
emily: repro I used locally: run 200 concurrent streaming clients that cancel early (client stops iterating before stream ended). small script below: 
```
async def worker():
    stream = client.stream_chat("hi")
    async for chunk in stream:
        if some_condition():
            break  # user aborts early
```
after running this 5-10 minutes fds keep growing.
marta: That matches what we saw in PR 501 where streaming iterator was refactored to spawn a background read task. If iterator is abandoned we never awaited cleanup path. We added a note in the changelog but missed explicit finalizer.
keith: Repro on my laptop with uvloop + httpcore: confirmed. You can see unclosed sockets in lsof.
emily: Short-term mitigation: document pattern to always use `async with client.stream_*()` so client ensures close, or call `await stream.aclose()` when breaking early.
raj: We should also add a finalizer on StreamingResponse and make __del__ call `self._ensure_closed()` and increment metric `sdk.stream.abandoned`.
marta: Agreed. I'll open an issue and PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-python-sdk/issues/505 with repro, logs, and fix plan.
keith: Also add a unit test where iterator is garbage-collected after partial consumption to ensure no leak. Add CI job that runs leak detector in a simple stress test.
ci-bot: created issue #505 and opened draft PR #512 to add finalizer + docs update.
emily: For onboarding: add a small note in quickstart: "For streaming endpoints prefer `async with client.stream_*()` or call `await stream.aclose()` when cancelling early" — saves customers from this trap.
raj: Also add a warning log when GC finalizer runs indicating abandoned stream so SRE can correlate.
marta: Will add telemetry, the finalizer, docs, and tests in PR #512. Thanks for the quick triage team.
